title: Notes
subtitle: The notes on your computers. Everyone who opens Notes on a computer shares the same notes.
action.noAddress: This note has no web address right now.
action.copyReadOnlyHint: Opens the note with editing turned off. It doesn't change who can edit: anyone who opens it can still turn editing back on.
action.copyAgentHint: A command an agent on {{computer}} can run to read this note. An agent without access to this notebook can't read it.
action.copyAgentNo: This note's address can't be written as a command.
col.title: Title
moreComputers: Showing the first {{shown}} computers. Open the others from Computers.
empty.title: Notes live on your computers
empty.body: Notes are saved on a computer. Get a computer to start writing notes.
empty.allNone: Notes are saved on each of your computers, and none of them has a note yet.
empty.c.failed: {{names}} gave no full list of notes.
empty.c.denied: Ask the owner for access to notes on {{names}}.
state.partial: Some recent notes may be missing.
state.older: Notes here is too old to list recent notes. Update it.
state.protected: Notes here is protected. Open Notes to sign in.
state.cantTell: The Hub could not tell whether Notes answered. Try again.
state.unexpected: Notes sent an answer the Hub does not understand.
state.busy: Notes is busy. Try again in a moment.
state.noAccess: You do not have access to this notebook.
state.notOwner: Only the owner of this computer can see its notes here.
state.stopped: This computer is stopped. Start it from Computers.
state.starting: This computer is starting. Its notes show when it is ready.
state.attention: This computer needs attention before its notes can be read.
new.title: New note
new.offAll: None of these computers can take a new note from here right now.
new.offHere: Notes on {{computer}} can't take a new note from here.
new.body: On {{computer}}, in {{section}}. Everyone who opens Notes on this computer will see it.
new.bodyNoSection: On {{computer}}. Everyone who opens Notes on this computer will see it.
new.quickTitleName: Now: name it with the date and time
toast.holdNotKept: This browser could not remember the pending note. Stay on this page until it is confirmed.
new.allowAgain: Stop tracking and allow creating again
new.allowAgainBody: The earlier note may already exist. Creating it again could make a second copy. Only continue if you have looked and it is not there.
new.sendingOut: This note is being created right now, in another tab or on the Board. Check again once Notes has answered.
new.unsure: Not confirmed yet. It may still arrive, or it may not have gone through.
new.pending: The Hub could not confirm whether the note was created. Check again before adding it a second time.
new.notClaimed: The Hub could not keep track of this note here, or another tab or the Board is creating one on this computer. Try again.
new.cantAdd: You are not allowed to add notes on this computer. Nothing was added. Ask its owner for access, or use another computer.
new.protected: Notes on this computer is protected. Open Notes to sign in, then try again. Nothing was added.
new.noPlace: Notes has no place for a new note. Open Notes to add one. Nothing was added.
new.gone: This notebook is gone. Nothing was added.
new.taken: Notes did not accept the new note. Nothing was added.
err.control: Remove line breaks or invisible characters from the title.
err.long: The title can have at most 200 characters.
toast.downloadFailed: The note could not be downloaded
toast.downloadTooBig: The note is too large to download
note.cantShow: This note cannot be shown here. Open it in a new tab.
note.noComputer: This note's computer is not in this list.
note.noComputerBody: It may be in another realm, or no longer on this account. Choose its realm, or look for it in Computers.
note.noAddressBody: Its computer has no web address yet, so its Notes cannot be opened from here. Refresh in a moment, or check the computer in Computers.
note.title: Note
delete.title: Delete this note?
delete.body: “{{title}}” on {{computer}} will be deleted for everyone, with everything inside it. It cannot be brought back.
delete.bodyUntitled: This note on {{computer}} will be deleted for everyone, with everything inside it. It cannot be brought back.
delete.pending: The Hub could not confirm whether the note was deleted, so it may already be gone. Check again before doing anything else with it.
toast.deleteGone: {{note}} isn't in this notebook any more.
toast.deleteNoNotebook: {{note}} is in a notebook Notes can't find any more.
